capabilities: Plan goals with due dates, starting from foundations and working up
Grade concept knowledge as solid, shaky, learning, rusty, or not started via diagnostic quizzes
Generate and study flashcard decks in one sitting
Chat with the tutor and attach slides, PDFs, or images from allowed folders
Publish the concept map to your Groundwork profile (optional)
extras: Freemium: free tier with monthly limits, $6 bring-your-own-model and $20 hosted plans. Desktop-only. Account is required before the tutor runs; tutor memory lives on the account, not the vault. README includes detailed network, privacy, and filesystem disclosure. Flashcard ratings do not affect concept-map marks; publishing the map is off by default.
problem: Obsidian stores what you write but has no built-in way to diagnose what you know, plan study toward a dated goal, or quiz you on it.
